notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello 
Here is the changelog for the 1.1 update:

Gameplay changes:
Removed choice requirement for “Tell them what they want to hear” during the interrogation in Bucha. Now you can select that choice. 


Localization changes:
Various fixes in Japanese localization
Various fixes in Ukrainian localization
Various fixes in Russian localization

Most fixes are based on players' feedback, so if you see any issues - let us know and we will try to fix everything asap. 

With Best Regards from Kyiv
Starni Games team

notes.title: Update 0.2: 6 new languages added!
notes.content:
6 new languages added! 

Update 0.2 

Added 6 new languages to the Demo:
German
Simplified Chinese 
Traditional Chinese (was not announced before)
Korean 
Japanese (was not announced before)
Finnish (was not announced before)

Added the SUPPORT UA button in the main menu with links to key charities that directly support Ukraine. These are the funds that are trusted by the people of Ukraine. We will keep the page updated to make sure that only the most reputable and effective funds are there. As we said from the very beginning, we do not profit from the project and no money goes through us. However, some players suggested making a page with a reputable funds list for the convenience of those who want to support Ukraine in these difficult times. 

We have great news! Volunteers from different countries agreed to help us with adding new languages to the project. We are really thankful to everyone who participated in the translation and proofreading. 

This means we now have at least 3 new languages that were not announced before, where we already have good progress in terms of localization, so now they are available in the Demo: 

Japanese 
Chinese (Traditional)
Finnish 

Big thanks to the new volunteer translation teams:

Japanese translation by 

Satsuho Akiyama
Nurikabe
Masaru Funahashi
Yuki Mitani


Chinese (Traditional) by

Gene Lin
CToID
Gordon Chiu
and others

Finnish translation by 

Gleb Shumaev
Zalminen
RadiumFI
and others


There are a couple more languages in the works, so hopefully, we will be able to further expand the number of languages of the game. 

Also, the work on the project goes well, so we expect a timely release in October 2022. 

With best regards from Kyiv
Starni Games team

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1 | French and Polish languages added
notes.content:
Hello guys!

This is our very first community hub post and it is made on a good occasion - our first Demo update. 

In the 0.1 Update we:
 - Added French localization
 - Added Polish localization
 - Fixed some typos in other languages
 - Added Subscribe to newsletter button (We will soon start sending letters with exclusive information about the project development)
 - Fixed various minor issues

Known issues to be fixed:
 - At some screen resolutions text might not fit the UI correctly. We plan to deliver a fix in the next update.

We plan to bring more languages in the next Demo updates so stay tuned.

More news about the project will soon follow. 

With best regards from Kyiv
Starni Games team
